purpose: Monte Carlo simulation of LCR and NSFR under Basel III stress (CRR Art. 412/428, EBA GL/2017/01). 1,000 paths × 250 time steps. P5–P95 percentile distribution, breach probability, time-to-breach, sensitivity tornado.
